title: Local Model Evaluation Harness
tagline: Evaluate recorded local-model responses with exact-answer accuracy, calibration error, and latency percentiles. Keep model execution separate from measurement.
summary: Evaluate recorded local-model responses with exact-answer accuracy, calibration error, and latency percentiles. Keep model execution separate from measurement.
youWillBuild: A runnable Python command and JSON report. The reference demo runs on deterministic local fixtures; you can feed the same functions your own data.
usefulFor: Use this artifact to inspect a real local dataset before connecting a model or an external service.

languageWhy.Python: The standard library makes parsing, scoring, and failure handling visible without hiding the mechanism behind a framework.
